Pharmacokinetic Cmax of AGuIX: maximal plasma concentration (Cmax) of AGuIX

agents.drug_class_hint: AGuIX: polysiloxane gadolinium-chelate nanoparticle, investigational radiosensitizer (and MRI contrast), intravenous

role_evidence.quote: standard of care : chemoradiotherapy (radiotherapy + temozolomide) for patients randomized in control arm of phase II

coder_notes: AGuIX is a gadolinium-based nanoparticle registered as a Drug; its presumed role is radiosensitisation, but the record does not state an antitumour mechanism. device_dependent set false because the activating modality is radiotherapy (not a device-enabled delivery/activation as defined in C12); an adjudicator may consider it radiation-activated. Not radioactive, so radiopharmaceutical = false. Tumour exposure is planned via MRI contrast enhancement in tumour vs healthy tissue (plus plasma PK), coded tumour_pk_planned = yes. Control is a registered SHAM_COMPARATOR arm (standard chemoradiotherapy), so control_arm_from_other_arms = no. cns5_terminology historical because of 'grade IV glioblastoma' (Roman numeral WHO 2016 grading) without IDH requirement; could be read as unclear.
